P3.text: P3: Persist coherent local materialization. Implement atomic durable state/frontier/definition/source/authority/retry/outcome/stall/pending-tail/floor restore for host and browser, with explicit trusted-local-storage restore verification. Bind semantic identity and actual Node integrity/build provenance or trusted browser bundle. Exercise crash boundaries, corruption, corrected build/dependency changes, stalls and rollback. Fresh deserialization must not mint VerifiedHistory without restore verification; byte-equivalent full replay.

Deliver code/tests plus a dated notes/ results report and raw evidence where appropriate. Report actual results, recommendation, trust/functional limits and unrun cases. Review any unsettled contract decision before implementing it; obtain atseq-reviewer exact-head architecture/security/simplification approval, then merge through gitseq and push main. No latency threshold or spike compatibility requirement.

P4.text: P4: Implement portable checkpoints and independent audit. Implement ordinary native records plus content-addressed blobs, certified app/genesis/head/frontier/payload/index/evidence commitments and separately bootstrapped certifier authority. Prefer native PDS certification as reviewed under D0; do not let checkpoint self-authorize. Preserve newer floors and two assurance dimensions (state derivation, identity observation). Provide early-use/deferred-audit and full-replay policies, selective historical outcomes, progress and audit-failure recovery; test lying state/authority/index, substitution, missing blocks and post-action audit mismatch.
